news.headline: Thread claims $6B+ in memecoin volume came almost entirely from non-outside traders
news.coins: "Anthropic" token on BNB Chain (no ticker given)
news.detail: @cryptoblaney (5.6K followers) says someone generated over $6 billion in memecoin trading volume, nearly none from real outside traders, starting with a trending token called Anthropic on BNB Chain. Early thread; 99 impressions, 2 likes so far. Claim not independently verified.

news.coins: BTC, BNB and SAFU-themed meme spin-offs

news.coins: BTC, BNB and SAFU-themed meme spin-offs

news.headline: Binance reveals record $6.3B hot-wallet theft
news.coins: BTC, ETH, TRX, USDT and meme spin-offs
news.detail: Attributed to North Korea's TraderTraitor group. About $3B frozen; Binance says it will cover losses from its Secure Asset Fund. Bitcoin dipped toward $76K. This is the backdrop for the SAFU and Lazarus joke coins.

news.headline: Users joke about pointing the hackers at Pump.fun
news.detail: Memes and satire after the hack, including 'Lazarus-WSOL' markets and a 1 billion LAZARUS token mint. X's summary says most treat it as satire.

news.headline: Pump.fun callout rewards, Creator Program and $100K competition
news.detail: Callout rewards pay daily USDC; one trader showed a $32,000 day. A Creator Program and a $100,000 competition start Nov 2. Critics question the payout and funding.

news.headline: Analysis: dev wallets buy early on 21% of 8.2M Pump.fun launches
news.detail: Dev-linked wallets bought in the first block, taking a median 10% of supply. Trader losses average 88.5% across 12 platforms and 97% on Pump.fun. ZeruAI pitches 'Activity Markets' as an alternative.

news.detail: The summary says memecoin market cap is about $30B, versus $150B at the late-2024 peak, and most tokens are down 90% or more from highs.

news.headline: Murad: community memecoins will outlast utility tokens
